project_hierarchy.program: Omni-Device Multi-AI Learning and Business Continuity

session_environment.platform_detail: ChatGPT Business planning and GitHub-connected implementation

objective.session_objective: Create a durable cross-device, multi-AI, broadband input/output continuity architecture for Prompt #11 and the Encyclopedia of Everything Applied.
in_scope: iPhone, iPad, ASUS laptop and Zo Computer role definitions
ChatGPT, Gemini/NotebookLM and Claude/Fabric Hermes independence
GitHub canonical state and Slack collaboration boundaries
programming, blockchain, AI, cybersecurity and entrepreneurship learning ladder
Continuation Packet schema, template, example and handoff contract
quality, privacy, security, accessibility and environmental controls
out_of_scope: handling passwords, private keys or restricted personal records
acceptance_criteria: Canonical architecture is committed to a Prompt #11 feature branch
Continuation Packet has a human-readable template and Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema
Platform roles and completion boundaries are explicit
Next work is prioritized and resumable from any authorized device

work_completed.summary: Created the Continuation Packet Markdown template.
Created the Continuation Packet Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema.
Created the machine-readable OMNI handoff contract.
Create and merge the canonical pull request.

decisions.decision: GitHub remains the canonical version-control and audit layer; chats and Slack are collaboration surfaces rather than the sole project record.
decisions.rationale: The project needs durable versioning, issue tracking, correction history and cross-device continuity.

decisions.decision: Every meaningful work session ends with a Continuation Packet.
decisions.rationale: A portable checkpoint prevents loss of decisions, sources, quality state and next actions during device or platform changes.

decisions.decision: ChatGPT, Gemini/NotebookLM and Claude/Fabric Hermes retain independent first-pass production lines.
decisions.rationale: Repetition between models must not be mistaken for independent verification.

claims.summary: The user intends to continue Prompt #11 from an iPhone, iPad, ASUS laptop, Zo Computer, Gemini/NotebookLM, Claude/Fabric Hermes, GitHub and Slack.
The architecture does not establish that every named platform is currently connected or synchronized.

noncritical_defects: External connectors are not configured or functionally tested

resume_prompt: Continue Prompt #11 from Continuation Packet P011-CP-OMNI-2026-08-22 v0.4. The current module is P-011-OMNI-001, workstream Canonical Architecture and Portable Checkpoint, and the highest-priority unblocked action is to finish and merge the OMNI GitHub pull request. Preserve model-line independence, public privacy classification, source provenance, Yellow RiskGate, and Quality and Quality Assurance as Job #1. Do not assume that external integrations, deployments, approvals, or synchronized files already exist. Confirm the feature-branch artifacts before executing the next action.
